field.label: Enable antivirus for downloads
field.help: Checks every file that is downloaded through the firewall: known malware hashes, virus signatures and risky file types.

field.label: Check plain web (HTTP) downloads
field.help: Unencrypted web downloads are checked automatically. Most sites use HTTPS, see below.

field.label: Also check HTTPS downloads from
field.help: Download sites whose encrypted traffic may be opened (needs DPI-SSL, the certificate on the devices and the privacy notice). With DPI-SSL set to "All HTTPS" every site is checked.

field.label: Known malware (hash match)
field.help: The MD5, SHA-1 and SHA-256 of the file are looked up in the malware lists from the cloud server, your own list and the EICAR test file.

field.label: Virus signatures
field.help: Rules that recognise malware by what is inside the file (YARA signatures from the cloud server). Start with "Monitor" and switch to "Block" when you are happy with the results.

field.label: Get hashes and signatures from the cloud server
field.help: Uses the cloud server address of Layer 7 > License.

field.label: Programs (exe, dll, ELF, Mach-O)
field.help: Based on the content of the file, not on its name or what the server claims.

field.label: Installer packages (msi, apk, jar, dmg, iso ...)
Archives (zip, rar, 7z, gz ...)
field.help: Archives are not opened; only the archive file itself is checked.

field.label: Your own blocked hashes
field.help: MD5, SHA-1 or SHA-256 hashes separated by commas.

field.label: Extra hash list address
field.help: Optional: a text or CSV file with SHA-256 hashes, one per line, for example an export from abuse.ch MalwareBazaar (needs a free key) or your own list.

field.label: Key for the extra hash list
field.help: Sent as an "Auth-Key" header (abuse.ch). Leave empty if the list needs none.

field.label: Never check these sites
field.help: Trusted download sites, separated by commas. Example: downloads.example.com

field.label: Largest file checked (MB)
field.help: Bigger files are not hashed; their type is still logged.
